# Configuration reference

Environment variables read by the image (`SYMB_MODE`: `all`, `gateway` or `node`). A secret also accepts `NAME_FILE=/path`. An invalid configuration stops the start with a message that names the variable; `node dist/main.js --check-config` validates without listening.

## Process

| Variable | Default | Required in | Secret | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SYMB_MODE` | `all` | — | no | `all` (gateway and node in one process, disk storage), `gateway` or `node`: role of the process. |
| `PORT` | `3000` | — | no | Listening port (0 to 65535; 0 lets the system pick a free port, for tests). Honours the value injected by the platform. |
| `NODE_ENV` | `production` | — | no | `production`, `development` or `test`. Only `test` enables the test flags; anywhere else their presence stops the start. |
| `SHUTDOWN_GRACE_SECONDS` | `270` | — | no | Draining grace period on SIGTERM, 1 to 300 seconds. |

## Database and key

| Variable | Default | Required in | Secret | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` | — | `all`, `gateway`, `node` | yes (`_FILE`) | PostgreSQL 16 to 18, `postgres://` or `postgresql://` scheme. |
| `MASTER_KEY` | — | `all`, `gateway`, `node` | yes (`_FILE`) | Exactly 32 bytes in base64 (44 characters), no passphrase. Generate it with `openssl rand -base64 32`. Back it up outside the platform: without it, secrets cannot be read. |
| `MASTER_KEY_PREVIOUS` | — | — | yes (`_FILE`) | Previous key, for the time of a key change; same format as `MASTER_KEY`. Remove it afterwards. |

## Node

| Variable | Default | Required in | Secret | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NODE_TOKEN` | — | `gateway`, `node` | yes (`_FILE`) | Secret shared by the gateway and the node, at least 32 characters. Not needed in `all` mode (the node registers on 127.0.0.1). |
| `NODE_PUBLIC_URL` | — | `node` | no | Private URL (http or https) announced to the gateway. In `all` mode: `http://127.0.0.1:<PORT>`. |
| `NODE_ID` | nom d’hôte | — | no | Stable node identifier (1 to 63 characters `A-Za-z0-9_.-`). |
| `NODE_REGION` | `default` | — | no | Region announced to the gateway (`a-z0-9_.-`, 1 to 40 characters). |
| `MAX_SESSIONS` | calculé (04b § 3) | — | no | Node slots, 1 to 64; overrides the value computed from the container memory. |
| `WARM_BROWSERS` | `1` | — | no | Pre-warmed Chromium instances (0 to 64). |
| `CONTEXTS_PER_BROWSER` | figé par la tâche 0.6 | — | no | Concurrent contexts per warm Chromium (1 to 64); unset: the constant measured by task 0.6. |
| `RECYCLE_AFTER_SESSIONS` | `50` | — | no | Sessions served before a Chromium is recycled. |
| `RECYCLE_AFTER_MS` | `3600000` | — | no | Age of a Chromium before recycling, in milliseconds. |
| `RECYCLE_RSS_PERCENT` | `90` | — | no | Memory threshold for recycling, in percent (1 to 100). |
| `HEARTBEAT_MS` | `5000` | — | no | Period of the node heartbeat to the gateway, in milliseconds (at least 100). |
| `SYMB_DATA_DIR` | `/data` | — | no | Session working directories (`sessions/{id}`), absolute path. |
| `SYMB_PRIVATE_HOSTS` | — | — | no | Private hosts reachable by the egress: exact names or CIDR, comma-separated. Empty: every private host is refused. |
| `SYMB_IP_ECHO_URL` | `https://api.ipify.org/?format=json` | — | no | HTTPS echo endpoint of the proxy test at session creation. |

## Gateway

| Variable | Default | Required in | Secret | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `QUEUE_MAX` | `50` | — | no | Global size of the session queue. |
| `QUEUE_MAX_PER_TENANT` | `10` | — | no | Queue size per client. |
| `QUEUE_TIMEOUT_MS` | `30000` | — | no | Maximum wait in the queue, in milliseconds. |

## Storage

| Variable | Default | Required in | Secret | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OBJECT_STORE` | `disk` | — | no | `disk` or `s3`. `all` mode only accepts `disk`. |
| `OBJECT_DIR` | `/data/objects` | — | no | Directory of the `disk` store, absolute path. |
| `S3_ENDPOINT` | — | — | no | Endpoint of an S3-compatible store (R2, MinIO), http or https URL; empty: AWS S3. |
| `S3_BUCKET` | — | — | no | Bucket; required with `OBJECT_STORE=s3`. |
| `S3_REGION` | — | — | no | Bucket region. |
| `S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID` | — | — | yes (`_FILE`) | S3 access key ID; required with `OBJECT_STORE=s3`. |
| `S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | — | — | yes (`_FILE`) | S3 secret access key; required with `OBJECT_STORE=s3`. |

## Limits

| Variable | Default | Required in | Secret | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SYMB_PROFILE_MAX_BYTES` | `104857600` | — | no | Maximum size of a persistent profile, in bytes (100 MB, to be confirmed). |
| `SYMB_DOWNLOAD_MAX_BYTES` | `524288000` | — | no | Cap per downloaded file, in bytes (500 MB, to be confirmed). |
| `SYMB_SESSION_DOWNLOAD_MAX_BYTES` | `2147483648` | — | no | Download cap per session, in bytes (2 GB, to be confirmed). |
| `SYMB_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES` | `104857600` | — | no | Cap per file upload, in bytes (100 MB, to be confirmed). |
| `SYMB_CDP_MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES` | `104857600` | — | no | Maximum size of a relayed CDP message, in bytes (100 MB, to be confirmed). |
| `SYMB_RECORDING_MAX_BYTES` | `209715200` | — | no | Cap per recording, in bytes (200 MB, to be confirmed). |

## Retention

| Variable | Default | Required in | Secret | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SYMB_RETENTION_TRACE_DAYS` | `7` | — | no | Retention of Playwright traces, in days. |
| `SYMB_RETENTION_HAR_DAYS` | `7` | — | no | Retention of HAR files, in days. |
| `SYMB_RETENTION_VIDEO_DAYS` | `7` | — | no | Retention of videos, in days. |
| `SYMB_RETENTION_LOG_DAYS` | `7` | — | no | Retention of session logs, in days. |
| `SYMB_RETENTION_DOWNLOAD_HOURS` | `24` | — | no | Retention of kept downloads, in hours. |

## Logs and access

| Variable | Default | Required in | Secret | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SYMB_LOG_LEVEL` | `info` | — | no | `trace`, `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error` or `fatal`: log threshold (JSON on stdout). |
| `SYMB_METRICS_TOKEN` | aucun (généré par keygen, tâche 0.3) | — | yes (`_FILE`) | Read token of `/metrics`, at least 32 characters. |
| `SYMB_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN` | généré au premier démarrage | — | yes (`_FILE`) | Token of `/setup` (first start), at least 32 characters. |
| `SYMB_BOOTSTRAP_API_KEY` | — | — | yes (`_FILE`) | First API key (client `sym`) created when the key table is empty; exchange key with SYM. At least 32 characters. |

## Test

| Variable | Default | Required in | Secret | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SYMB_TEST_MODE` | — | — | no | `1` under `NODE_ENV=test`: route `/v1/_test/process-info/{id}`. Anywhere else its presence stops the start. |
| `SYMB_TEST_ALLOW_PRIVATE` | — | — | no | `1` under `NODE_ENV=test`: the egress reaches the private fixtures. Anywhere else its presence stops the start. |
